svg.title: SMC CPU cluster
svg.desc: u_smc_cpu_wrapper holds u_smc_cpu (smc_4core_cpu), which wraps the Chipyard-generated u_digital_top (OCAH4CORECluster_DigitalTop). Inside it, four Rocket tiles each hold an RV64GC Rocket core with its FPU, a 4 KiB L1 instruction cache, a 4 KiB L1 data cache, a bus error unit and a TileLink master crossbar. Each tile master connects to the system bus sbus, which also takes the front bus fbus and drives the control bus cbus, the coherence manager coh_wrapper (TLBroadcast) and the TileLink-to-AXI4 bridge of the MMIO port. The cbus reaches the bus error unit of each tile, the CLINT, the PLIC, the debug module with its JTAG debug transport module, an error device and the periphery bus pbus with the four watchdog timers. The fbus merges the debug module's system bus access with the AXI4-to-TileLink bridge of the L2 frontend port. Behind the coherence manager the memory bus mbus reaches 32 scratchpad banks and the boot ROM port. At the u_smc_cpu boundary the L2 frontend port passes an axi_isolate that blocks new transactions, the MMIO port passes an axi_isolate that terminates them, the scratchpad bank interfaces pass the zero-fill sequencer, and reset sequencing and boundary isolation control sit beside them. In the wrapper, u_front_port_demux splits the front port from the SMC fabric (AXI4, 32-bit address, 64-bit data, 8-bit ID) between the L2 frontend and an AXI4-to-AXI-Lite converter for the cpu_ctrl registers in u_smc_cpu_ctrl_wrap, and tilelink_to_rom_mem converts the boot ROM TileLink port to the ROM macro interface. The MMIO port leaves to the SMC fabric as AXI4 with a 56-bit address and 3-bit ID. The 1 MiB scratch RAM (32 banks) and the 128 KiB boot ROM macros are outside the wrapper. The 328 interrupt lines enter the PLIC and JTAG enters the debug module.
